credentials_json_instructions:
IMPORTANT: The credentials.json file can ONLY be downloaded
when creating an OAuth client!

Instructions:

1. Go to: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials

2. Delete the old OAuth client (if any)

3. Click '+ Create Credentials' > 'OAuth client ID'

4. Application type: 'Desktop app'
   Name: any name

5. Click 'Create'

6. IMPORTANT: A window will immediately appear with the
   'DOWNLOAD JSON' button - click it!

7. Rename the file to credentials.json

8. Place it in the application folder

If you closed the window - create the client again!

oauth_error_400:
Error 400: Invalid request (invalid_request)

Problem: redirect_uri is not configured correctly

Solution:
1. Go to Google Cloud Console:
   https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials

2. Open your OAuth client (Desktop client)

3. Find the 'Authorized redirect URIs' section

4. Make sure it is added:
   urn:ietf:wg:oauth:2.0:oob

5. If it is not there - add it and save

6. Remove http://localhost from the list (if present)

7. Try connecting again
oauth_error_403:
Error 403: Application in testing mode

If you have already added an email to test users:

1. Check that the email was added correctly:
   - Must be exactly the same email you are using
   - No spaces before/after
   - Make sure you clicked 'Save'

2. Wait 1-2 minutes after saving

3. Try using 'Production' mode:
   - Go to: https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials/consent
   - In the 'Publishing status' section, select 'Production'
   - For personal use, this is allowed without verification

4. Clear browser cache or use incognito mode

5. Try connecting again through the application
